transcript:
**Agent:** Thank you for calling TechSolutions, this is Sarah. How can I assist you today?

**Customer:** Hi Sarah, this is Mike. I was charged twice for my Pro plan this month and I’m really confused about why.

**Agent:** I’m sorry to hear that, Mike. Let me take a look at your billing details. Can you confirm the email associated with your account?

**Customer:** Yes, it’s mike@example.com.

**Agent:** Thank you, Mike. Just a moment while I check that for you. *[pause]* I see that two payments were processed due to an auto-renewal and an additional upgrade you initiated last week. 

**Customer:** I didn’t mean to upgrade! I only wanted the Pro plan. Can I get a refund for the extra charge?

**Agent:** I understand your frustration, and I can definitely help with that. I’ll process a refund for the extra charge right now. You should see it on your statement within 3-5 business days.

**Customer:** Thank you! I appreciate it. But I’m still a bit confused about the upgrade process. 

**Agent:** No problem! When you signed in last week, there was a prompt about updating to our Enterprise plan, which may have led to the confusion. I can send you detailed information about our plans if you’d like.

**Customer:** Yeah, that would be helpful. I just want to ensure I don’t get charged for something I didn’t want again.

**Agent:** Absolutely, I’ll include a breakdown of all our plans and the features each one offers so you can make an informed decision moving forward.

**Customer:** Perfect, thank you! Is there anything else I need to do right now?

**Agent:** Just keep an eye out for my email, and feel free to reach out if you have any questions about your plan. 

**Customer:** Will do. Thanks again for your help today!

**Agent:** You’re welcome, Mike! Have a great day, and don’t hesitate to call us back if you need anything else.
